text: Hey Amy Double-Yoo - so I am not entirely sure a complaint by you would have the exactly same efficacy as one by a lawyer, but I would say that lawyers don't have inherently special powers to make things go faster. They can be pretty expensive, and so for me I would be sure to exhaust self-help options before going to a legal route. Regarding threats, personally it's not something that I would put in writing like that - I would tend to save any assertion for the in person meeting, and I would focus that on trying to get them to provide a reason/justification for the delay. Hoping things will progress soon 🙏🏻
